beats.label: hook
beats.text: Top 5 games dropping before Christmas. Number 1 has been in development for 8 years.

beats.label: rank_5
beats.text: Number 5. LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight. TT Games' most ambitious project, Batman's full origin story across six distinct eras.

beats.label: rank_4
beats.text: Number 4. Crimson Desert. Pearl Abyss spent six years building this open world RPG. Five million players bought it in the first month.

beats.label: rank_3
beats.text: Number 3. Marathon. From Bungie. A PvPvE extraction shooter where you die and lose everything you brought in.

beats.label: rank_2
beats.text: Number 2. EA Sports UFC 6. Markerless capture tech rebuilds every fighter's strikes, with a Flow State mechanic that unlocks signature moves.

beats.label: rank_1
beats.text: And number 1. Subnautica 2. Eight years after the original, the same studio is back with co-op multiplayer underwater survival.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Five games. Which one are you actually excited for?
